questions.q: What are the two ways to reach the Reports and Analytics catalog in Oracle Fusion?
options: A standalone work area from the Navigator, and a panel tab embedded in other work areas
Only through Microsoft Excel
Only through the Scheduled Processes work area
A mobile app and a desktop app, with no other options
questions.explain: The Navigator > Tools > Reports and Analytics work area and the embedded Reports and Analytics panel tab both open the same underlying catalog.

questions.q: What is the difference between Shared Folders and My Folders in the Reports and Analytics catalog?
options: Shared Folders are only for IT administrators
My Folders hold Oracle-seeded content and Shared Folders hold personal content
Shared Folders hold Oracle-seeded and organization-published content; My Folders hold content you personally created or saved
There is no real difference between the two
questions.explain: Shared Folders are visible to everyone with access; My Folders are private to the individual user unless explicitly shared.

questions.q: In the Reports and Analytics catalog, what is an "Analysis"?
options: A BI Publisher data model plus template
OTBI content built with drag-and-drop criteria against a subject area, for interactive ad hoc use
A Financial Reporting Studio grid report
A Smart View Report Package
questions.explain: In this catalog, "Analysis" specifically refers to OTBI content, distinct from a "Report," which is a BI Publisher object.

questions.q: In the Reports and Analytics catalog, what is a "Report"?
options: An Oracle Analytics Publisher / BI Publisher object built from a data model and a layout template
Any saved Smart View workbook
A synonym for Analysis — the two words mean exactly the same thing
A Financial Reporting Center account group
questions.explain: A Report in this catalog is specifically a BI Publisher object, usually built for precise, repeatable, often scheduled output.

questions.q: Why does it matter to know your way around the Reports and Analytics pane, even if you never build a report yourself?
options: It doesn't matter — only report authors ever open this pane
It lets you find a predefined report or re-run existing work instead of recreating it from scratch
It is required to log into Oracle Fusion at all
It replaces the need for the Financial Reporting Center entirely
questions.explain: A working consultant uses this pane constantly to locate predefined reports and previously saved analyses rather than duplicating work that already exists.
